name: @astontech/interview-shell
description: Local shell around Claude Code for interview rehearsal: spawns your own claude with the interview-rehearsal skill, voice input, and records the session to Aston's backend

scripts.sync-plugin: rm -rf plugin/skills && cp -R ../claude-plugins/plugins/interview-rehearsal/skills plugin/skills && cp ../claude-plugins/plugins/interview-rehearsal/.claude-plugin/plugin.json plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json
